recorded_from_commit_note: This file's own previous recording (recorded_from_commit: 'card/201-guide-page-how-to-solve (implementation commit)') was taken on the CARD-201 feature branch BEFORE it was merged into main, and main already held CARD-202's answer-section packing (width<=15/height<=20 small answers share 2-or-4 to a page) at that point -- CARD-201's branch predates CARD-202 entirely (verified: nonogram.admin.book_answer_key.PackedAnswerPage does not exist on that branch). So the stale recording's 13-page, four-full-answer-page book never actually matched what merging CARD-201 into main would produce. This re-recording is taken AFTER the merge, against the final combined code: CARD-201's 2-page guide AND CARD-202's packing both in effect. Pages 1-9 (the guide, the three level dividers, the two-up page, the two single-puzzle pages, and the SOLUTIONS divider) are CHECKED, NOT ASSUMED, byte-identical to the stale recording's own pages 1-9 -- CARD-202's packing touches only the answer section, never anything before the SOLUTIONS divider, by construction. Only the answer section moved: the stale recording's four full answer pages (10-13, one per puzzle, CARD-198's shape with no packing) become three packed-or-full pages (10-12: Duck+Owl share packed page 10, Tree packs alone onto page 11, Snowflake keeps its own full page 12) -- the book shrinks from thirteen pages to twelve.

why_a_new_baseline: Merging CARD-201 (2-page guide) into main (which already has CARD-202's answer-section packing) combines two independent effects that this file's stale, CARD-201-branch-only recording could not reflect: CARD-201 shifts every page from the first puzzle/divider page onward by +1 (the guide's second page) and flips its parity; CARD-202 shrinks the answer section from one full page per puzzle to 2-or-4 small answers packed per page, wherever they qualify (width<=15 and height<=20) and share a tier. Applied together on this book (Duck, Owl both 10x10 Easy; Tree 15x15 Medium; Snowflake 30x30 Hard): Duck+Owl share one packed page, Tree packs alone onto its own packed page (no other qualifying answer in its level), and Snowflake still gets its own full page -- three answer pages, not four, at interior pages 10-12, not 9-11 (CARD-202 alone) and not 10-13 (CARD-201 alone, no packing). Twelve interior pages in all.
warning: This is evidence of what the book PDF looks like with CARD-201 and CARD-202 both merged into main. It must NEVER be regenerated to make a test fail less: a digest that no longer matches means a page's ink changed, and an interior_bytes/colour_interior_bytes that no longer matches means the written file changed. If a later card deliberately changes either, it records a NEW baseline in a commit of its own, with its own card number, and says so here.
